book.name: Lukas
book.title: Varu Poia to Lukas Imbooda Luk—Luke

content: Saveeŋ palelaaŋ to naar to inoknok ghasoniiŋ pa ulaaŋ
Yesu isavia saveeŋ palelaaŋ tonene pa taghoniiŋa toni pa ipalot di. Leso tinidi imum pa suŋuuŋ sob, ve tisuŋ pa Maaron irau sawa isob. Ep 6:18; Kol 4:2; 1Tes 5:17
Ye isaav padi ighaze: “Ndug eez, daba todi to gharatooŋ saveeŋ imatughez pa Maaron maau, ve igham ŋgar pa tamtoghon eta maau.
Ndug tonowen, naar eez inepneep. Moghon moghon, ye ilala to daba tonenen, ve itaŋtaŋ rorani ighaze: ‘Ŋgar to koiag igham payou, nene deŋia maau. Uul ghou ve ugharaat saveeŋ tiou itaghon ŋgar deŋia.’

“Sawa mala, daba tonenen iyasiil pa ulaaŋ naar tonenen. Eemoghon ye inoknoki tovene le muri ghoro, daba tonenen isaav pa tau ighaze: ‘You namatughez pa Maaron maau. Ve tamtoghon paam, nagham ŋgar padi maau.
Eemoghon naar tonene inoknok pararaiŋ ghou ila ila le tinig imum pani kat. Tambaŋa. You pale nauuli ve nagharaat saveeŋ toni. Pa vene, inoknok saveeŋ payou tovene.’” Lu 11:7+
Ghoro Tiina toit Yesu isaav muul ighaze: “Alooŋ saveeŋ to daba samia tonenen wa?

Ighaze tamtoghon tovene ilooŋ naar tonenen aliŋa ve igharaat pataŋani toni, nene pale Maaron igham vena pa yes to ye tau isia di tinim le? Ighaze koiadi tigham sosor padi, ve yes titaŋ rorani pa mboŋ ve ndag, pale izuar pa ulaaŋ di? Maau. Mbo 88:1; Syg 6:10

You nasaav payam: Ye pale iuul di pa pataŋani todi rikia moghon, ve igharaat saveeŋ todi itaghon ŋgar deŋia. Eemoghon sawa to Tamtoghon Natu imuul inim, pale ighita yes to tineep izi taan ne tighur ila toni, ma maau?” 2Tim 3:1+
Saveeŋ palelaaŋ to ŋgeu to tutuuŋ ve ŋgeu to youŋ takes
Yesu isavia saveeŋ palelaaŋ tonene iŋarua ndiran pida to tinumeer taudi tighaze yes moghon tineep deŋiadi ila Maaron mata, ve matadi izi pa nditadi pida. Lu 16:15
“Sawa eez, ndiran ru tila Rumai Tiina tighaze tisuŋ. Eez, ye ŋgeu tutuuŋa. Ve ite, ye ŋgeu to youŋ takes.

Ŋgeu to tutuuŋ ila iyoon, ve isuŋ ila lolo ighaze: ‘Oo Maaron, you napait ghom toman lolog poia. Pasa, you nanimale tamtoghon pida maau. You nayub maau, naghur maat maau, ve ŋgar to deŋia ila matam, you nayel pani rita maau. Ŋgeu to youŋ takes tonene paam, you nanimale ye maau. Is 1:15; Syg 3:17

Wik to naol ne, you naŋgun taug pa ghaniiŋ aniiŋ pae ru itaghon suŋuuŋ ŋgara. Ve moghon moghon, mbeb tisob to nagham di, matag iŋgalŋgal pa valagiiŋ di tinim ndouŋ saaŋgul, ve naghamgham ndouŋ eŋaeŋa payom.’ Mt 23:23

“Ye isuŋsuŋ, ve ŋgeu to youŋ takes iyoon saguan. Mata iza maau. Itud, ve ipambar ate toman taŋiiz. Pasa, lolo ipataŋan pa sosor toni. Tovenen isaav moghon ighaze: ‘Oo Maaron, you ŋgeu to ghamuuŋ sosor. Lolom isamin ghou, ve ureu sosor tiou ilale!’” Mbo 51:1; Is 57:15

Ghoro Yesu iseeŋ saveeŋ toni ighaze: “You nasaav payam. Sawa to ŋgeu to youŋ takes ivot ila pa ruum toni, Maaron ighita ighaze ye moghon to ŋgeu deŋia. Ve ita ite tonowen, ne maau. Pasa, tamtoghon tisob to tipait taudi, nene pale Maaron itatan di. Ve ighaze tamtoghon eta itatan tau iza, nene pale Maaron ipaiti.” Lu 14:11; Yems 4:6; 1Pe 5:5+
Yesu ipalot ndipain
Tamtoghon tigham ndinatudi geegeu paam tila to Yesu, leso ighur nima izala poghodi ve ipalot di. Taghoniiŋa toni tighita di, ve tiyaan di.

Eemoghon Yesu ipoi ndipain tonowen timuul tinim, ve isaav pa taghoniiŋa toni ighaze: “Ai, yam apoon ataam pa ndipain malep! Apul di tinim tiou. Pasa, pooz to Maaron toman ndug toni, nene to yes to ŋgar todi inimale ndipain tonene.”
You nasaav payam kat. Ighaze tamtoghon eta itaghon pooz to Maaron ŋgara inimale ndipain tonene maau, ye irau ilooŋ ila ndug toni maau. Mt 18:3
Mbaliiŋ tau eez isavsaav toman Yesu
Daba eez to yes Yuda ighason Yesu ighaze: “Patoŋaaŋ, yom poiam. Pale nagham vena, leso naneep matag iyaryaar le alok?”
Yesu ipamuul ghasoniiŋ toni ighaze: “Pughu vena to yom ughaze you poiag? Maaron moghon to poia. Ite paam maau.
Tutuuŋ to naol ne, yom uwatag di wa: ‘Ughur maat malep, urab tamtoghon imaat malep, uyub malep, upariaaŋ saveeŋ kaarom malep, ve matam loŋloŋaiŋa pa tamam ve tinam ve utandag padi.’” Igham 20:12+
Ŋgeu tonowen ilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, ve isaav pa Yesu muul ighaze: “Wai patoŋaaŋ, sawa to pain ghou ve inim aazne, you nataghon tutuuŋ tonenen tisob.”

Yesu ilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, ve isaav pani muul ighaze: “Poia. Ve ŋgar eez to yom ughami sone. Ula ugholia mbeb tiom tisob, ve urei yaama pa yes mbolaaŋa, leso ugham lem mbaliiŋ tau izi ndug sambam. Le isob, ghoro unum utaghon ghou.” Mt 6:19+; Lu 12:33; Mbaŋ 2:45
Ŋgeu tonenen ilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, le lolo ipataŋan kat. Pasa, ye mbaliiŋ tau kat.
Yesu ighita ŋgeu tonenen lolo ipataŋan, ve isaav ighaze: “Yes mbaliiŋ taudi, ipataŋan padi kat pa titaghon pooz to Maaron ve tilooŋ tila ndug toni. Lu 8:14; 1Tim 6:9+

Aghita. Ighaze kamel itoova pa izeev tau ilooŋ ila sarum saambu, pale iraua wa? Maau. Yes mbaliiŋ taudi tovene paam. Ighaze taudi titoova pa titaghon pooz to Maaron ve tilooŋ tila ndug toni, nene pale tiraua maau.”
Yes tilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, ve tighason Yesu tighaze: “Wai, ighaze venen, sei to pale Maaron igham mulini ve ineep pooi izi ndug toni?”
Yesu ipamuul aliŋadi ighaze: “Mbeb to tamtoghon irau tighami maau, nene Maaron irau ighami. Pasa, mbeb eta irau ila Maaron muri maau.”
Yes to titaghon Yesu pale tigham sa atia?
Tovenen Petrus isaav pa Yesu ighaze: “Ughita. Yei tonene nipul ndug tiei toman mbeb tiei tisob tizi tineep, ve ninim nitaghon ghom.” Mt 4:19+; Lu 5:11
Yesu isaav padi ighaze: “Onoon kat, you nasaav payam. Ighaze tamtoghon eta igham ŋgar pa pooz to Maaron, ve ipul ruum toni, azuwa, toŋvetaz toni, tina tama, ma ndinatu,

nene pale Maaron iyat mbeb to tamtoghon tonenen ipul di irau pae katindi. Pasa, sawa to ye ineep izi taan, poia tiina to Maaron pale iza toni le ilib kat pa mbeb toni tisob tonowen. Ve sawa to Mboŋ Muri ighaze ivot, ye pale ineep mata iyaryaar le alok.”
Yesu isaav muul pa mateeŋ ve mundigiiŋ toni

Ghoro Yesu igham taghoniiŋa toni saaŋgul ve ru tila saguan, ve isaav padi ighaze: “Alooŋ. Iit taghaze tala pa Yerusalem tonene. Ve saveeŋ isob to yes propeta timbooda iza to Tamtoghon Natu, nene pale anoŋa ivot. Mbo 22; Is 53:3-7
Pale tighuri ila yes to Yuda maau ne nimadi, ve tipamogherani, tipamayaŋini, ve tivuragi.
Ghoro tilosi pa waar mata mata, ve tirabi imaat. Eemoghon mboŋ inim tol, ye pale imundig pa mateeŋ.”
Taghoniiŋa toni tilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, eemoghon tighazooŋ pa pughu rita maau. Pasa, pughu iyooŋ padi. Tauto tikankaan pa Yesu saveeŋ toni.
Yesu igharaat ŋgeu mata pisi eez igharau Yeriko
Yesu ilaagh ila le igharau ndug Yeriko, ve ivot to ŋgeu mata pisi eez. Ye mbole izi ataam dige, ve isuŋsuŋ tamtoghon pa le mbeb.
Ŋgeu tonowen ilooŋ ival tiina tinim le tighaze tisalib pani. Tovenen ighason di ighaze: “Ou, nene vena?”
Yes tipamuul aliŋa tighaze: “Wai, Yesu to Nasaret inim ila we.”
Tovenen ye imboob aliŋa tiina ighaze: “Yesu, David Natu, lolom isamin ghou ve uul ghou lak!”
Yes to tilaagh timuuŋ, tiyaan ŋgeu tonenen tighaze neneeŋa. Eemoghon ye itaŋ roran Yesu muul toman aliŋa tiina kat ighaze: “Aa David Natu, lolom isamin ghou ve uul ghou lak!”
Tovenen Yesu aghe tuŋia, ve isaav pa tamtoghon pida ighaze: “Akis ŋgeu tonanan nima ve aghami inim.” Ŋgeu tonenen inim igharaui, ve Yesu ighasoni ighaze:
“Yo, ughaze nagham vena payom?” Ye ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “Aa tiina tiou, naghaze yom ugharaat matag. Leso naghita ndug.”
Tovenen Yesu isaav pani ighaze: “Matam poia ve ughita ndug lak! Ghurla tiom, tauto iuul ghom ve matam poia wa.”

Rikia moghon, ŋgeu tonenen mata poia ve ighita ndug. Tovenen ipapait Maaron iza pa tapiri ve poia toni, ve itaghon Yesu ve yesŋa tila. Ve ival tiina to tinepneep ve tighita mbeb gharatooŋa tonenen, tisob tipait Maaron iza paam. Yo 9:1+

footnotes.text: Ndipain geegeu tinumeer nditamandi ve nditinandi ve tineep ila sambadi. Iit paam irau tanumeer Maaron ve taneep ila ye samba. Leso tataghon pooz toni, ve muri talooŋ tala ndug sambam.
